name: Working Hard
overview: Scripture teaches that working hard is both a divine mandate and a source of blessing. From Genesis, where God placed man in the garden to cultivate and keep it, to Proverbs, which contrasts the satisfaction of diligent labor with the emptiness of laziness, the Bible highlights the value of productive effort. The Psalms affirm that God establishes the work of our hands, underscoring that diligent labor aligns with His purposes and brings profit, while mere talk leads to lack.
